rules.check: the logic, error handling, empty-value checks and resource release of the changed code are correct
rules.evidence: the line that breaks the rule

rules.check: callers of changed exported symbols still work and a task intends the change
shared data is guarded, locks are ordered, and goroutines can end
rules.evidence: the unguarded access or the goroutine start

rules.check: paths, case, line endings and signals do not assume one platform
hard limits, schema versions and gate fixtures of embedded data are kept
rules.evidence: the changed line of the data file

rules.check: changed behaviour has tests, and named documents are touched
rules.evidence: the changed function with no test

rules.check: names, repetition and comments follow the standards of the brief
rules.evidence: the declaration that breaks the standard
